title: pnc3.net Semi-Anarchy
description: This server is incredible with its two modes both focused on survival, one being a classic Minecraft experience with only one rule, no hacks.
body:
Come join us on the pnc3 network and play on the classic Semi-Anarchy mode with over a year old never-reseting world with lots of cool builds.

The server will be online frequently due to its simplicity there is not much maintenance needed.
